proposals.statement: Parents struggle to get information from the school because fee statements are printed and sent home in learners' bags but half never reach parents

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents.

proposals.statement: Parents phone the client about fees they didn't know they owed

evidence.quote: Then I have parents phoning me about fees they didn't know they owed.

proposals.statement: Reports are printed, put in envelopes, and sent home but take a week of admin staff's time every term for about nine hundred learners

evidence.quote: Printed, put in envelopes, sent home. For about nine hundred learners that's a week of the admin staff's time every term.

proposals.statement: Notices like sports fixtures or school closures go on WhatsApp broadcast lists and email but parents who change numbers fall off the list

evidence.quote: Those go on WhatsApp broadcast lists and by email. But a broadcast list fills up so we have five of them now and parents who change their numbers just fall off.

proposals.statement: Absence notes are handwritten in the learner's homework diary or emailed to the class teacher who may not pass them to the office, leading to a learner being marked absent for three days without office knowledge

evidence.quote: handwritten in the learner's homework diary or an email to the class teacher who may or may not pass it on to the office. We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to see current balance, monthly statement as PDF, and reference for EFT

evidence.quote: Current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: The portal must release term reports as PDF on the same day for all parents

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to report their child's absence with reason and dates, and notify the class teacher and office immediately

evidence.quote: Yes, the reason and the dates and the class teacher and the office both see it straightaway.

proposals.statement: The portal must handle notices from the office and grade heads for the whole school or specific groups

evidence.quote: Notices from the office and from the grade heads, either to the whole school or just to one grade or one team.

proposals.statement: School Base is a system that runs on a server in the admin block since 2014 and holds learners' fees and marks

evidence.quote: On a server in the admin block. It's School Base seven from about twenty fourteen I think. It holds the learners' the parents' fees and marks.

proposals.statement: School Base does not have APIs and the supplier has not responded to queries about APIs

evidence.quote: Not that I know of. I've asked the supplier and they haven't answered yet.

proposals.statement: Parents have smartphones but data is expensive and most are unprepaid, so the portal must be light and small pages

evidence.quote: Most of our parents have smartphones but data is expensive and I'd say most of them are unprepaid.

proposals.statement: Bursary families count every megabyte, so the portal must be light and small pages

evidence.quote: our bursary families especially count every megabyte.

proposals.statement: The portal must be light, small pages, and PDFs only downloaded when opened

evidence.quote: So the portal has to be light, small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The portal must be zero rated by the network for parents with limited data

evidence.quote: Yes. And could it be zero rated? I heard some schools have arranged that with the networks.

proposals.statement: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner

evidence.quote: These are children's records, reports, the medical reasons on absence notes, family addresses. Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner.

proposals.statement: The portal must respect restrictions per parent, including court orders for about a dozen files

evidence.quote: and with some divorced parents, one of them may not see anything at all. There's a court order on about a dozen files.

proposals.statement: The Finance Committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand Rand for the first year all in, but the Board must approve it

evidence.quote: The Finance Committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand Rand for the first year all in, but the Board has to approve it, and they only meet on the twenty eighth of January.

proposals.statement: The portal must be hosted in South Africa as per the Board's decision

evidence.quote: The Board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last Board meeting.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal should support Isizulu language for notices and main screens

evidence.quote: English is the school's language but a lot of our grandparents look after the children and they're more comfortable in Isizulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in Isizulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal must be accessible to users with visual impairments using screen readers

evidence.quote: Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the P T A who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal must support Isizulu language and accessibility for parents with vision impairments and screen readers

evidence.quote: English is the school's language but a lot of our grandparents look after the children and they're more comfortable in Isizulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in Isizulu too, that would mean a lot.
clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the P T A who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The school has a budget of 250,000 Rand for the first year, pending Board approval on January 28th

evidence.quote: The Finance Committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand Rand for the first year all in, but the Board has to approve it, and they only meet on the twenty eighth of January.

proposals.statement: The school has limited IT resources with only one person handling IT work on two days per week

evidence.quote: Me honestly. I'm the only IT person and only two days a week.

proposals.statement: The portal must deliver Term 2 reports by June 26th

evidence.quote: The Term 2 reports go out on the 26th of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal.

proposals.statement: The school wants to start with a trial of grade 8 reports in April to test the portal before full rollout

evidence.quote: I like that. Let's do grade 8 in April as the trial.
Agreed. Grade eight first.

proposals.statement: The portal must use the school's maroon color scheme instead of generic blue

evidence.quote: please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.
